lessons.text: Captain choice: prefer highest ep_next, but discount players with very few minutes (under 500) for start risk.
Value picks: cheap players with high ep_next (4.5-5.5m, e.g. Henderson, Neto) often beat expensive ones per £m.
Keep bench covering each position with valid formation (at least 3 DEF and 2 MID in XI); use a DEF and MID sub first.
